item.title: DOF buys two Aurora Offshore anchor handlers in $100m fleet upgrade
item.description: Norwegian offshore vessel owner DOF has entered into an agreement to purchase the Aurora Saltfjord and Aurora Sandefjord anchor handlers from Aurora Offshore. item.title: Transocean bags more work for three semisubs
item.description: Swiss-based offshore drilling giant Transocean has secured additional work for three of its harsh-environment semisubmersibles. Transocean said in its fleet status report that the Transocean Enabler was awarded three fixtures by Equinor for a total of seven wells in Norway, at a dayrate of $455,000. item.description: New York-listed tanker owner DHT Holdings has secured its second high-paying time charter this week, fixing one of its 2012-built VLCCs at $94,000 per day for one year.
